additional_info.subject: Summary of Onsite Visit : 7-09-2025
additional_info.body:
Summary of Onsite Visit:
During a recent onsite visit, we addressed operational issues with DC converters in DC2 and DC3, which were successfully resolved by replacement. A persistent fault was also identified with Outlet 3, which requires further investigation and Level 3 support due to suspected configuration issues and limited access.
Detailed Findings and Actions:
DC Converter Issues (DC2 & DC3)
Observation:
Two converters in
DC2
were found to be non-operational.
One converter in
DC3
was found to be non-operational.
Action Taken:
The identified faulty converters were replaced with new units.
Resolution:
Post-replacement, all converter faults cleared, and the units are now functioning as expected.
Outlet 3 Issue
Observation:
Outlet 3 is experiencing a persistent fault.
Action Taken:
The State Monitor for Outlet 3 was changed.
Dip Switch settings for Outlet 3 were verified and confirmed to be correct.
Current Status:
The fault on Outlet 3 remains despite the troubleshooting steps taken.
Analysis:
Based on the actions performed, a hardware problem is considered unlikely. We suspect the issue is related to the
EcoG configuration
for Outlet 3.
Request for Support:
We require
Level 3 support
to further diagnose and resolve the issue with Outlet 3. We believe the problem lies within the EcoG configuration, and we currently
do not have SSH access
to verify or modify these settings.

additional_info.subject: 0440237 - ID0440237-DC/Si-DC/BE-[MP / PD 170001337] Plug 3 is in error. CRM:00472000380
additional_info.body:
Dear Chloe,
Following our investigation, we have identified that the issue affecting Outlet 3 is related to the ecog module.
We propose two potential solutions to resolve this, and we would appreciate your guidance on which approach you would prefer:
Direct ecog Firmware Update:
Description: This solution involves updating the ecog firmware directly to version v1.4.11 or a later version.
Process: We can perform this specific ecog firmware update remotely on the charger without requiring a full charger firmware upgrade.
Charger Firmware Update (including ecog update):
Description: Alternatively, the issue can be resolved by updating the charger's main firmware to the new version v8.0.5.
Process: This comprehensive update for the charger's main firmware includes the necessary ecog firmware update (v1.4.11) as part of the package.
Please let us know which of these solutions you would prefer to proceed with. Once we receive your preference, we will initiate the necessary steps to schedule and perform the update.
Should you have any questions or require further clarification, please do not hesitate to contact us.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
